description: Non-secret configuration settings for Salesforce REST gateway.

instance_url.description: Base origin URL of the Salesforce instance (e.g. 'https://example.my.salesforce.com')
instance_url.title: Instance Url

api_version.description: Explicit REST API version in 'vNN.0' format (e.g. 'v60.0')
api_version.title: Api Version

client_id_ref.description: Opaque reference or key name for OAuth Connected App client ID
client_id_ref.title: Client Id Ref

credential_ref.description: Opaque reference for protected refresh token or credential secret
credential_ref.title: Credential Ref

expected_org_id.description: Expected Salesforce Organization ID (15 or 18 chars)
expected_org_id.title: Expected Org Id

expected_user_id.description: Expected Salesforce User ID (15 or 18 chars)
expected_user_id.title: Expected User Id

approved_origins.description: Explicit list of approved HTTPS origins; instance_url and token_url origins are added automatically
approved_origins.title: Approved Origins

total_call_timeout_seconds.description: Monotonic logical operation deadline in seconds
total_call_timeout_seconds.title: Total Call Timeout Seconds

max_total_sends.description: Maximum total HTTP requests per logical operation
max_total_sends.title: Max Total Sends

max_resource_sends.description: Maximum resource HTTP requests per logical operation
max_resource_sends.title: Max Resource Sends

max_token_sends.description: Maximum token acquisition/renewal requests per logical operation
max_token_sends.title: Max Token Sends

max_response_bytes.description: Maximum allowable response payload size in bytes (10 MiB default)
max_response_bytes.title: Max Response Bytes

title: SalesforceSettings
